title: The new geography of growth (Web Summit LIS26 session page)
what_it_says: Web Summit's session page: 'The new geography of growth', November 10, 2026, 15:20 to 15:40 (Lisbon time), Stage 7, track Corporate Innovation Summit. Description: As companies rethink where they build, invest and scale, cities and countries are becoming strategic partners in corporate expansion. Rio de Janeiro and Qatar are building tech hubs designed to attract technology companies, talent, capital
